notes: Book chapter (InTech, 2011) on the CnanoHx-LiH system. Methods are TDMS/TG/DSC, XRD, neutron diffraction and GC. The 5.0 mass % H2 figure is the amount desorbed from the rehydrogenated composite by TG (main, PDF p. 9-10, book p. 87-88, Fig. 7 caption: "the hydrogen desorbed from the each rehydrogenated composite ... estimated by the results from GC and TG"), and the TG loss is stated to include some hydrocarbon. It is a desorption (thermal desorption with TG) quantity, not a gravimetric, volumetric or flow measurement of uptake from the gas phase, so I1 is not met. Not coded theoretical_only (experimental data are shown) or electrochemical (gas-phase H2). is_retracted is false in record.json and the PDF does not say retracted. Borderline point for the resolver: the chapter re-presents results from earlier articles (figures and methods cite Miyaoka et al. 2007, 2008, 2009; 'The details of sample preparation are shown in the previous articles') and could be read as a review of the authors' own work (not_primary), but it does not call itself a review and shows data, so not_primary was not applied. Either reading leads to exclusion.
